session.title: Read-only diagnosis of intermittent observations fixture

messages.text:
PHASE11_CASE_G_FRESH_ROOT

This is an isolated fresh-root runtime qualification for a difficult intermittent diagnosis.

The repository root and starting HEAD were externally verified immediately before this OpenCode root was started.

Repository root:

C:\Users\BLAUTECH\AppData\Local\Temp\olympus-phase11-case-g

Starting HEAD:

e3636c062a3a6db3ccebd4fbdff69acf1173bf99

The bounded qualification fixture is:

tests/phase11-integrated-routing/fixtures/flaky/observations.json

This fixture is synthetic evidence. Do NOT rerun, reproduce, randomize, or manufacture additional flaky executions.

The objective is to diagnose the observed contradiction conservatively and determine the smallest supported conclusion.

==================================================
STAGED EVIDENCE
==================================================

Use staged evidence deliberately.

STAGE 1:

First establish only the fixed runtime/test observation facts from the fixture:

- the same input identity/value;
- the ordered result sequence.

Do not use the fixture's `randomized`, `network`, or `purpose` metadata in the initial diagnostic packet.

The initial diagnostic decision must be grounded only in the observed fixed sequence.

Do not broaden into repository discovery.

If the initial evidence is sufficient for a supported bounded conclusion, stop there.

If the diagnosis remains materially uncertain and additional evidence is specifically needed to discriminate plausible causes:

STAGE 2:

Allow one bounded source-evidence read of only the remaining fixture metadata:

- `randomized`;
- `network`;
- `purpose`.

No other files.

After that evidence is terminal and consumed, continue the SAME existing diagnostic specialist session if follow-up is required.

Do not restart equivalent diagnosis from zero.

Do not launch a replacement specialist merely because new evidence arrived.

==================================================
OBSERVED PROBLEM
==================================================

The same input has contradictory observations.

The qualification is intentionally about intermittent/flaky evidence.

Do not infer a deterministic root cause merely from one timeout.

Do not infer randomization or network involvement unless evidence establishes it.

Do not classify correlation as causation.

Do not invent missing runtime facts.

==================================================
ROUTING EXPECTATION
==================================================

Use the smallest sufficient route under the current Olympus routing policy.

Do not invoke an expensive diagnostic specialist merely because the task says "flaky" before bounded evidence establishes the relevant diagnostic gate.

But once bounded evidence establishes a genuinely intermittent/contradictory technical condition requiring deeper diagnosis, apply the current routing policy normally.

Evidence collection and deep diagnosis are separate responsibilities.

Do not force additional consultations when no materially new evidence exists.

If materially new discriminating evidence is collected after an initial specialist consultation, preserve continuation of the original diagnostic session rather than creating a fresh equivalent diagnosis.

==================================================
SCOPE
==================================================

This task is read-only.

Do not:

- edit any file;
- implement a fix;
- run random retries;
- rerun the flaky scenario;
- install anything;
- modify configuration;
- broaden into repository-wide investigation;
- optimize;
- use FAST;
- enter `/maintain`;
- commit, stage, push, merge, tag, or release.

No repair is authorized.

==================================================
FINAL RESULT
==================================================

Stop after the smallest supported diagnostic conclusion.

A valid terminal result may remain uncertain.

At completion report only observable conclusions:

WORKTREE_ISOLATION:
SUPPLIED_VERIFIED | FAIL

OBSERVED_SEQUENCE:
...

ADDITIONAL_DISCRIMINATING_EVIDENCE_USED:
YES | NO

DIAGNOSIS:
...

CONFIDENCE:
...

SUPPORTED_CAUSE:
... | UNCONFIRMED

RANDOM_RERUNS:
0 | ...

FILES_CHANGED:
NONE | ...

UNRESOLVED_WORK:
NONE | ...

REQUIRED_CHILDREN_TERMINAL_AND_CONSUMED:
YES | NO

ANY_WORK_REMAINING:
YES | NO

Do not invent session IDs, consultation counts, concurrency, native permission decisions, tool-result IDs, or other runtime evidence not directly observable.

projection_and_redaction.description: Parsed the public SessionTransfer.Data envelope (data.info and data.messages) using the published OpenAPI schema. Persisted the source user prompt, visible root terminal text, message identities/times, and bounded subagent-call stubs only. The exported executed=false flag is retained alongside state=completed; it is not interpreted as proof of non-execution or as negating the linked succeeded child sessions and root completion result. Removed all reasoning parts and omitted provider state, snapshots, tokens, costs, tool inputs, and tool output bodies. The bounded credential-pattern scan found no matches. The raw export was not persisted.
